Hi Alice,

Thanks again for the quick product samples — we're ready to start the onboarding steps for billing. To get the vendor record and PO flow set up on our side we need a few items from you: 

- Unified Business Number (統一編號 / UBN) exactly as it should appear on invoices
- Confirmation whether you issue 電子發票 (e-invoice) and a small PDF sample we can map fields against
- Official billing name (English + Chinese if different) and the exact billing address you want on the PO/invoice
- Bank remittance details (bank name, branch, account number, SWIFT/BIC); note our AP team needs SWIFT if we book cross-border payments
- Any local tax withholding requirements we should be aware of when Redwood bills through our US or Singapore entity

I'm attaching our PO template and a supplier onboarding checklist (short form). If you can return the UBN + e-invoice sample + bank details, we'll create the vendor in our system and issue the first PO.

Target timeline from our side: vendor record created within 2 business days of receiving the items above, PO raised the same day.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if you prefer.

Best,

Thanks for flagging, Sean. Quick guidance from tax/AP: 

- Preferred billing entity: Redwood Singapore PLC (AP/Finance recommends Singapore for AP flows in APAC to minimize US withholding complexity). We will record the vendor UBN and the e-invoice PDF as supporting tax evidence.
- For Taiwan suppliers: collect UBN, e-invoice sample, bank details (SWIFT) and a supplier bank confirmation letter where possible. No standard "W-8" equivalent required, but keep a local tax residency attestation if vendor requests non-withholding treatment.
- Withholding: we don't expect Taiwan VAT on our side (e-invoice is VAT evidence). Withholding on certain service categories can apply; we will not automatically withhold unless legal/tax instructs. If vendor is asking for gross-up language, let finance know.

Monica — please:
- Create vendor record under Redwood Singapore ledger, attach Formosa_UBN_copy.pdf and sample_einvoice_20260828.pdf in the vendor file.
- Map the e-invoice number field to our invoice number and capture the UBN into the tax ID field.
- Set preferred currency to TWD and payment method to SWIFT wire (USD payments acceptable but flag for FX conversion).

I will follow up with a short checklist we require in the vendor file.

Irene Choi
Head of Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
